## POWERS DOCUMENTATION — RE-VERIFIED 2026-08-26, UNCHANGED. The finding still holds.
Three install paths: curated marketplace at kiro.dev/powers (partners incl. Datadog, Figma, Stripe)
one-click "Add to Kiro"; **any public GitHub repository URL** (one repo can hold MULTIPLE powers, each
in its own directory); a local folder for private repos. Each needs a `plugin.json` or `POWER.md`.

*** THE CORE FINDING, STILL TRUE: ***
  Agent Plugins format (plugin.json): "MCP servers are managed internally by Kiro and are **not added
    to your user-level ~/.kiro/settings/mcp.json** file."
  Legacy format (POWER.md): servers DO register in ~/.kiro/settings/mcp.json under a Powers section.
  => whether an MCP server is visible in the canonical config file depends PURELY on packaging format,
     and the newer/standard/marketplace-endorsed format is the INVISIBLE one. Any collector that
     enumerates MCP servers by reading mcp.json systematically under-reports, in the direction the
     whole industry is converging on.

*** STILL NO SIGNING, VERIFICATION OR TRUST CONTROL DOCUMENTED. *** The only stated control remains
advice: "Kiro powers are third-party tools that may be subject to separate terms. Only install powers
from trusted sources."

Other properties carried forward (unchanged):
- Activation is DYNAMIC and content-driven: Kiro "reads the task description, evaluates installed
  powers against the task, and loads only relevant powers into context", keyed on activation keywords
  declared in plugin.json => INSTALLED != ACTIVE, and the active set is a function of prompt text.
- Custom agents carry per-agent `mcpServers` / `tools` / `toolAliases` grants.
- MCP config exists at BOTH workspace and user scope, and BOTH hot-reload from disk via a file watcher
  on `.kiro/agents` and `mcp.json` — capability sets change mid-session with no restart, no UI event.
- AGENTS.md: "do not support inclusion modes and are always included", "automatically discovers them
  in subdirectories throughout your workspace". Kiro's own steering files DO have always/fileMatch/
  manual/auto modes; AGENTS.md has none. Global `~/.kiro/steering/` applies to ALL workspaces.

## URGENCY (inherited, not speculative)
Amazon Q Developer IDE plugins reach end of support **2027-04-30** and AWS names Kiro as the
replacement — an installed base is being migrated onto this surface.

Updated: 2026-08-26 — no new releases, docs unchanged. RECOMMEND ADDING kiro.dev/changelog + /docs.
